dialogues.speaker: Philby
dialogues.text: Thanks for the approval. It gives me confidence in my own decision.

dialogues.speaker: Philby
dialogues.text: It does look pretty safe with so many Forest Rangers here.

dialogues.speaker: Philby
dialogues.text: A young girl with green hair tried to say something to me when she heard that I'm a Mondstadter, but she didn't say anything in the end.

dialogues.speaker: Philby
dialogues.text: What was up with that? I was too tired to bother asking for details. I'll ask about it should I meet her again.
